none: PAS DENO-507624: Roman Coin: Radiate of Carausius
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman Coin: Worn hammered copper alloy radiate of Carausius (286-93), probably a contemporary copy or a very early issue from an Unattributed Mint. The remains of the reverse inscription [ ]ABON(N/A) suggest Abundantia, Annona or even [FORTVN?]A BONA. This coin might be inspired by pieces of Gallienus and/or Claudius II, or might be original.
